shots.prompt: The mouse finds a wedge of cheese on the kitchen table. The cat peeks around the doorway, eyes widening. Hold a readable establishing pose, then a gentle push-in.
The mouse snatches the cheese and darts right. The cat reacts one beat late, compresses into a crouch, then launches into a chase. Both silhouettes remain clear; movement stays left-to-right.
The cat skids around a kitchen corner and flour puffs into the air. The mouse slips under a chair while protecting the cheese. Use a comic anticipation and impact beat.

The cat leaps for the cheese but lands in a flour sack. A soft white puff clears to reveal a flour-covered cat blinking in surprise while the mouse takes a tiny bite of cheese. Hold the final comic pose.
